product: MechWarrior 4: Vengeance official Patch 3 (English, Inner Sphere Mech Pak media)
classification: local compatibility evidence; redistribution not authorized

qualifiedExperiment.method: Applied the official RTP payload to disposable retail and Patch-2 trees through a source-owned x86 asInvoker host. Product setup may load only these exact user-media engine/payload inputs inside coordinator-owned scratch; neither proprietary component is distributed or retained. SafeDisc player routines were emulated, never executed natively.
qualifiedExperiment.result: Patch 3 applies directly to original retail Vengeance. Its output matches the Patch-2-then-Patch-3 path except for Patch-2-only drvmgt.dll, so Patch 2 is not a prerequisite. The source-owned exact-input transform emits a disc-free executable and removes the CdaC14BA.dll and ARTPCLNT.dll import descriptors.

managedExecutable.smoke: The managed executable removes both legacy import descriptors and replaces two deferred C-Dilla plus two AutoRTPatch call sites with call-convention-correct local results, including explicit stdcall argument cleanup. A packaged two-pack tree remained responsive for 35 seconds with an empty game log and without mounted media, elevation, C-Dilla, or ARTPCLNT.
